**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (reviewed at the effort:high tier: geometry feeding toolpaths).

## What looks good
- The tolerance weld is a fallback only: `slice` keeps the exact 1 um key and re-slices tolerantly only on `SliceError::Open` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs`), so every mesh that sliced before slices bit-for-bit as before. A genuinely open mesh is still refused by name (`a_tenth_of_a_millimetre_gap_is_still_open`).
- Tolerances are bounded and named: `WELD_TOL` = 2 um and `CELL` = 4 um (`slice_weld.rs:28,32`), `SLICE_NUDGE` (1 um) for the section retry. Merging corners 2 um apart cannot move a chord end by more than 2 um, below what the region layer (1 um grid) resolves, so no gouge or boundary error can come from the weld. A mesh that is still non-manifold after welding still falls into the existing "every end shared by exactly two chords" check and is refused.
- No panics or unchecked indexing in the new code: `.get()` lookups, `saturating_add` on bucket keys, casts bounded by the existing horizon check.
- The `facet_shadow` union (`picks.rs`) makes every facet shadow material, so the silhouette used as a Face clip can no longer lose material to nesting parity. Degenerate shadows are dropped by area.
- The empty-section refusal now names the Z span and how to fix it. The retry 1 um lower only happens on an empty answer; a plane really outside the part still refuses.
- Pinning tests are good and the PR notes the revert check. Decision file `docs/decisions/241-cutouts-ops.md` present, no snapshot PNG, golden or CHANGELOG edits, no process files, no new dependencies or `build.rs`/scripts changes. Provenance line on the new module.

## Local results (merged with upstream/main v0.18.0, clean merge, own target, sccache)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-geometry (all suites, incl. `slice` 12 passed) | pass |
| camcraft-app `face_holes` 3, `top_plane_noise` 2, `golden_cl` 25, `blind_floor` 7, `solid_law` 4, `whole_model_pocket` 5, `area_picks` 5, `pick` 9 | pass |
| camcraft-app `--lib` | 114 pass |
| camcraft-motion `blind_floor` 2, `face_holes` 7, `face_concave_holes` 3, `solid_law` 6, `machining2d` 66 | pass |
| clippy `-D warnings` geometry + app, all targets | clean |

I did not re-run the full ui/sim/post batch; the author's batch-scope gate (9 steps, green on this head) covers it and the diff does not touch those crates.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
- `slice.rs` has a doubled blank line after the module docs (where `use std::collections::HashMap;` was removed) and `cargo fmt --check` is not clean on the files I looked at; the geometry-crate diffs reported were in an untouched file, so this looks pre-existing. A tidy-up is optional.
- The tolerant weld is greedy nearest-within-2 um, not transitive; fine at this scale, worth remembering if the tolerance is ever widened.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
